primary.note: Operator-themable seed. Default = NRW red; Ruhr preset = #005D9E; custom themes override at runtime.

signal-red.note: Fixed across presets. Drives the accent gradient and the hue-mix for all danger/alarm signals.

heading.note: Headings and links read blue, deliberately separate from the brand slot.

heading.purpose: Page and section titles (h1, weight 700, Heading Blue).

body.purpose: Default reading text, 16px / 1.6, system sans. Cap prose 65–75ch.

label.purpose: Form labels and control captions, weight 600.

data.purpose: JetBrains Mono for times, coordinates, IDs, and the radio log only.

shadows.name: card-ambient
shadows.purpose: Resting card/panel elevation. Suppressed entirely in the 'dezent' intensity.

shadows.name: modal-lift
shadows.purpose: Dialog elevation above a blur(4px) backdrop.

shadows.name: focus-ring
shadows.purpose: Keyboard/hover focus ring on primary controls.

motion.name: transition-standard
motion.purpose: Default state transition ('ausgewogen'). 0.15s in 'lebhaft'; none in 'dezent'.

motion.name: blink-timer
motion.purpose: Critical-timer attention blink. Needs a reduced-motion equivalent.

motion.name: pulse-critical
motion.purpose: Out-of-area / critical state pulse on the map and panels.

breakpoints.name: mobile
breakpoints.note: max-width: touch spacing, sidebar collapse, mobile field views.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Default primary action; brand-filled, theme- and intensity-aware, ≥44px touch target.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.4rem; min-height: 44px; padding: 12px 24px; border: 1px solid var(--theme-primary-border, #8a231d); border-radius: 0.55rem; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--theme-primary, #A72920) 76%, var(--ui-surface, #ffffff)); color: var(--theme-on-accent, #ffffff); font: 600 1rem 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.2s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover, .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { background: var(--theme-primary, #A72920); box-shadow: 0 0 0 0.2rem color-mix(in srgb, var(--theme-primary, #A72920) 20%, transparent); outline: none; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Neutral secondary action; ink text kept off the accent so tinted fills stay legible.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { min-height: 44px; padding: 12px 24px; border: 1px solid var(--ui-border, #d5deea); border-radius: 0.55rem; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--secondary-color, #404040) 12%, var(--ui-surface, #ffffff)); color: var(--ui-text, #1f2937); font: 600 1rem 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.2s ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover, .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--secondary-color, #404040) 20%, var(--ui-surface, #ffffff)); outline: none; }

components.name: Theme Accent Button
components.description: Signature expressive control: a primary→signal-red gradient with a tinted shadow. Flattens to a soft tint in 'dezent'.
components.css: .ds-accent-btn { min-height: 44px; padding: 12px 24px; border: 1px solid var(--theme-tertiary-border, #a8040d); border-radius: 8px; background: linear-gradient(135deg, color-mix(in srgb, var(--theme-primary, #A72920) 76%, #fff) 0%, color-mix(in srgb, var(--theme-tertiary, #E3000F) 22%, #fff) 100%); color: var(--theme-on-accent, #ffffff); font: 600 1rem 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 2px 10px color-mix(in srgb, var(--theme-tertiary, #E3000F) 14%, transparent); transition: all 0.2s ease; } .ds-accent-btn:hover { background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--theme-primary, #A72920) 0%, color-mix(in srgb, var(--theme-tertiary, #E3000F) 58%, #fff) 100%); }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Touch-optimized field with a blue focus glow.
components.html: <label class="ds-label">Einsatzort<input class="ds-input" type="text" placeholder="Adresse oder Koordinaten" /></label>
components.css: .ds-label { display: block; font: 600 1rem 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; color: var(--ui-text, #1f2937); } .ds-input { display: block; width: 100%; margin-top: 8px; min-height: 44px; padding: 12px 16px; border: 1px solid var(--ui-form-border, #c6d2e4); border-radius: 8px; background: var(--ui-form-bg, #ffffff); color: var(--ui-form-text, #1f2937); font: 400 1.1rem 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--ui-muted, #617083); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: var(--ui-form-focus-border, #4a88c7); box-shadow: 0 0 0 0.2rem rgba(74,168,255,0.2); }

components.name: Card
components.description: Resting surface container with a themed gradient header. Flat in 'dezent'.
components.html:
Team 1 — Rex
Flächensuche · Abschnitt Nord
components.css: .ds-card { border: 1px solid var(--ui-border, #d5deea); border-radius: 12px; background: var(--ui-surface, #ffffff); box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.08); overflow: hidden; } .ds-card__header { padding: 1.25rem; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--ui-card-header-border, #d6dfeb); background: var(--ui-card-header-bg, linear-gradient(90deg, #f3f6fb 0%, #edf1f8 100%)); color: var(--ui-card-header-text, #2b3a4f); font: 600 1rem 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-card__body { padding: 1.5rem; color: var(--ui-text, #1f2937); }

components.name: Status Badge
components.description: Pill status chip pairing color with an icon — never hue alone.
components.html: Außerhalb Suchgebiet
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.35rem; padding: 0.35em 0.7em; border-radius: 999px; font: 600 0.82rem 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-badge--danger { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--signal-danger-hue, #e12431) 92%, var(--ui-surface, #fff)); color: #ffffff; }

components.name: Sidebar Nav Item (active)
components.description: Command-rail link in active state: inset brand-tinted left bar + tinted background.
components.css: .ds-nav-item { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.6rem; min-height: 44px; padding: 0.5rem 1rem; color: var(--ui-sidebar-text, #1f2937); text-decoration: none; font: 500 1rem 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; transition: background 0.2s ease; } .ds-nav-item:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, currentColor 12%, transparent); } .ds-nav-item--active { font-weight: 600; background: color-mix(in srgb, currentColor 18%, transparent); box-shadow: inset 3px 0 0 color-mix(in srgb, currentColor 75%, transparent); }

components.name: Theme Alert
components.description: Inline informational callout tied to the active theme.
components.html: GPS-Halsband verbundenLive-Position wird auf der Karte angezeigt.
components.css: .ds-alert { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 0.65rem; padding: 0.75rem 0.9rem; border: 1px solid var(--theme-primary-border, #8a231d); border-radius: 8px; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--theme-primary, #A72920) 12%, var(--ui-surface, #fff)); } .ds-alert i { margin-top: 0.1rem; color: var(--theme-primary-text, #A72920); } .ds-alert strong { display: block; color: var(--ui-text, #1f2937); } .ds-alert__text { color: var(--ui-muted, #617083); font-size: 0.82rem; }

narrative.overview: A calm command surface. An Einsatzleiter in the ELW reads the whole operation at a glance while the interface stays composed until something genuinely demands a response. The same system folds down to a Hundeführer's phone in daylight without losing its vocabulary. The identity is not a fixed brand color — it is the architecture beneath it: operators choose a preset (NRW red, Ruhr blue) or a custom theme, and the surface re-derives from two seed colors through color-mix, on top of a three-step intensity engine (dezent / ausgewogen / lebhaft) and full light/dark theming.
keyCharacteristics: Token-derived, not hue-fixed — operator-themable primary/secondary, fixed signal anchors.
Intensity-tunable — dezent / ausgewogen / lebhaft gate color, motion, shadow, and radius.
Glanceable — status is shape and position before it is prose.
Quiet by default — saturated color, motion, and audio are scarce escalation, not decoration.
Field-ready — ≥44px touch targets, legible outdoors, full dark mode.

rules.name: The Re-Derivation Rule
rules.body: Never hardcode a hex value in a component. Every color comes from a token (--theme-*, --ui-*, --signal-*). If a new element breaks when the operator switches preset, toggles dark mode, or changes intensity, it is wrong.

rules.name: The Reserved-Brand Rule
rules.body: The saturated brand primary appears on primary actions, current selection, and active state only — never as decoration. Headings use Heading Blue, not the brand.

rules.name: The Fixed-Scale Rule
rules.body: Type sizes are a fixed rem scale, never clamp()-fluid. Users work at a consistent DPI across desktop and mounted tablets.

rules.name: The Mono-For-Data Rule
rules.body: JetBrains Mono is for machine-readable values only (times, coords, IDs, radio traffic). Never for prose, buttons, or non-data labels.

rules.name: The Intensity-Gated Depth Rule
rules.body: Any new shadow or glow must be expressed through the intensity tokens so dezent stays flat and lebhaft can amplify it.

dos: Do drive every color from tokens (--theme-*, --ui-*, --signal-*) so operator presets, custom themes, dark mode, and intensity all keep working. Test a new screen under NRW + Ruhr + dark + each intensity.

Do pair every status color with a second channel — icon, shape, label, or position — so red/green-deficient users and a phone in sunlight read the same state. The Grün→Orange→Rot timer is the test case.
Do keep the saturated brand primary scarce: actions, current selection, and alarm only.
Do gate new shadows and motion behind the intensity engine so dezent stays flat and silent.
Do keep touch targets ≥44px and body/muted text ≥4.5:1, especially in the mobile field views.
Do use JetBrains Mono for data (times, coordinates, IDs, radio log) and the system sans for everything else.
donts: Don't hardcode hex values in components or bypass the token layers; it breaks theming and dark mode.
Don't rely on color alone to convey team, dog, or timer state.
Don't use the brand red (or any seed) as decoration, or color headings with it — headings are blue.
Don't ship blinking/pulsing alerts without a prefers-reduced-motion equivalent that mirrors dezent.
Don't reach for a modal as the first answer; exhaust inline and progressive disclosure first.
Don't let it drift toward a generic Bootstrap admin template or a playful, gamified consumer app.
